description: Fetches the most recent air-quality reading for a location. Defaults to the AirGradient public sensor at WELLNESS_AIR_DEFAULT_LOCATION (or pass locationId).

privacy_mode.description: Optional privacy mode: summary | structured | raw. summary omits location identifiers and device serials when present; structured/raw return full payload.

provider.description: Provider to query. Defaults to airgradient.

name: air_current_reading
title: Air current reading
